widget.instructions: A swinging pendulum shows the same exchange: watch the energy bars.

stem: A ball is dropped from {{h}} m. Ignore air resistance.
What happens to its energy as it falls?

options.text: Potential energy turns into kinetic energy; the total stays the same
Its energy is used up as it falls

hints.text: Where is its potential energy greatest?
With no air resistance, nothing is lost.

energy-destroyed.text: Energy isn't used up: the height (potential) energy becomes energy of motion (kinetic).

generic.text: PE → KE; total energy is conserved.

workedSolution.text: Lower height: less PE. Faster: more KE.
The total mechanical energy stays the same.

energy-destroyed.front: A falling ball loses height. Where does the energy go?
energy-destroyed.back: Into kinetic energy (and a little into heat with air resistance).

generic.back: PE becomes KE; the total is conserved.

accessibility.nonDragAlternative: Choose an answer with the radio buttons.
